name: nimbus
description: Nimbus — a lightweight, local-first agent workspace (desktop + mobile) inspired by Grok Build's agent architecture.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/*" run build
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --parallel --filter @nimbus/server --filter @nimbus/web run dev
scripts.desktop:dist: pnpm --filter @nimbus/agent-core build && pnpm --filter @nimbus/server build && pnpm --filter @nimbus/web build && pnpm --filter @nimbus/desktop run dist
scripts.desktop:dist:win: pnpm --filter @nimbus/agent-core build && pnpm --filter @nimbus/server build && pnpm --filter @nimbus/web build && pnpm --filter @nimbus/desktop run dist:win
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules apps/*/dist packages/*/node_modules packages/*/dist
